arxiv-1903-09081.title: Large enhancement of conductivity in Weyl semimetals with tilted cones: Pseudorelativity and linear response
arxiv-1903-09081.creator: Saber Rostamzadeh, İnanç Adagideli, Mark Oliver Goerbig
arxiv-1903-09081.description: Abstract We study the conductivity of two-dimensional graphene-type materials with tilted cones as well as their three-dimensional Weyl counterparts and show that a covariant quantum Boltzmann equation is capable of providing an accurate description of these materials’ transport properties. The validity of the covariant Boltzmann approach is corroborated by calculations within the Kubo formula.

arxiv-2104-12018.title: Parikh’s theorem for infinite alphabets Thanks: This work was partially supported by NCN grants 2016/21/D/ST6/01368, 2017/27/B/ST6/02093 and 2019/35/B/ST6/02322. PubID: pubid: 978-1-6654-4895-6/21/$31.00 ©2021 IEEE
arxiv-2104-12018.creator: Piotr Hofman, Marta Juzepczuk, Sławomir Lasota, Mohnish Pattathurajan
arxiv-2104-12018.description: Abstract We investigate commutative images of languages recognised by register automata and grammars. Semi-linear and rational sets can be naturally extended to this setting by allowing for orbit-finite unions instead of only finite ones. We prove that commutative images of languages of one-register automata are not always semi-linear, but they are always rational.

arxiv-2406-14183.title: Latent Functional Maps: a spectral framework for representation alignment Thanks: Equal Contribution
arxiv-2406-14183.creator: Marco Fumero *, Marco Pegoraro, Valentino Maiorca, Francesco Locatello, Emanuele Rodolà
arxiv-2406-14183.description: Abstract Neural models learn data representations that lie on low-dimensional manifolds, yet modeling the relation between these representational spaces is an ongoing challenge. By integrating spectral geometry principles into neural modeling, we show that this problem can be better addressed in the functional domain, mitigating complexity, while enhancing interpretability and performances on downstream tasks.

pmc-11434410.title: Wide pH, Adaptable High Internal Phase Pickering Emulsion Stabilized by a Crude Polysaccharide from Thesium chinense Turcz.
pmc-11434410.creator: Borong Ling, Lijun Shao, Huicong Jiang, Shufang Wu
pmc-11434410.description: The ultrasound-assisted extraction conditions of Thesium chinense Turcz. crude polysaccharide (TTP) were optimized, and a TTP sample with a yield of 11.9% was obtained. TTP demonstrated the ability to stabilize high-internal-phase oil-in-water emulsions with an oil phase volume reaching up to 80%. Additionally, the emulsions stabilized by TTP were examined across different pH levels, ionic strengths, and temperatures.

pmc-11438168.title: Inflammatory and immune variables as predictors of survival in dogs with myxomatous mitral valve disease
pmc-11438168.creator: Martina Cimerman, Natalia Druzhaeva, Alenka Nemec Svete, Melita Hajdinjak, Katka Pohar, Alojz Ihan, Aleksandra Domanjko Petrič
pmc-11438168.description: BackgroundWe aimed to investigate the association between selected inflammatory and immune variables and survival of dogs with myxomatous mitral valve disease (MMVD). We evaluated data of 62 client-owned dogs with MMVD, grouped into preclinical, stable congestive heart failure (CHF) and unstable CHF.

pmc-11546052.creator: Vitaliano Nicola Quaranta, Andrea Portacci, Francesca Montagnolo, Silvano Dragonieri, Ilaria Iorillo, Ernesto Lulaj, Leonardo Maselli, Enrico Buonamico, Giovanna Elisiana Carpagnano
pmc-11546052.description: Background/Objective: Patients with severe asthma (SA) and non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis (BE) without microbiological colonization represent a unique and understudied population. Type 2-targeted biologic therapies have emerged as a promising treatment for these patients. However, predictive factors for achieving clinical remission remain unclear.

pmc-12821846.title: Impact and evolution of minimal invasive surgery in a centralized colorectal service: trends, safety and oncological outcomes across 15 years
pmc-12821846.creator: Ali Toffaha, Mahmood Al-Dhaheri, Sherif Ahmed, Ayman Ahmed, Ibrahim Amer, Mahwish khawar, Ammar Aleter, Ejaz Latif, Hamza A Abdul-Hafez, Salwa Ahmed, Mohammed Yousif, Noof Al Naimi, Mohamed A Kurer, Amjad Parvaiz, Mohamed Abunada

AimSpecialization with subsequent evolving minimally invasive surgery (MIS) has been increasingly adopted in colorectal cancer care. pmc-13121145.creator: Tianfei Zheng, Dongfeng Guo, Yaqi Shi, Cunyong Zhang, Jinlong Zhou, Kun Zong, Guiming Hua, Xingjiang Li
pmc-13121145.description: IntroductionEnriched microbial consortia have been proven to effectively regulate agricultural fermentation, yet their practical applications in the fermentation of cigar tobacco leaves are still limited.MethodsIn this study, three natural microbial communities collected from high-quality cigar tobacco leaves were continuously cultured in a medium made of ordinary cigar tobacco leaves to construct enriched stable consortia via the top-down approach.

Simader, Krzysztof Macierzanka, Kayla Chiew, Sannidhya Misra, Rupert Williams, Klio Konstantinou, Jehangir N. Din, Shah R. Mohdnazri, Peter D. O’Kane, Peter Haworth, Sukhjinder S. Nijjer, Henry S
pmc-13236056.description: BACKGROUND:In stable coronary artery disease, the primary goal of percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) is symptom relief. Fractional flow reserve (FFR) and nonhyperemic pressure ratios such as resting full-cycle ratio (RFR) are used to guide revascularization. Although these indices correlate with myocardial ischemia, they have never been validated against the onset of angina.

pmc-13456939.title: Pulse Index Continuous Cardiac Output-Guided Hemodynamic Therapy in Living Donor Kidney Transplantation: A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-13456939.creator: Van Dung Le, Huu Tu Nguyen, Quang Thuy Luu, Minh Hoang Thach, Thi Thuy Trang Tran, Van Dong Pham, Francis Zamora, Gary TA-Wei Yu, Viet Hoang Dinh
pmc-13456939.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCentral venous pressure (CVP)-guided fluid therapy remains common during kidney transplantation, although CVP is a static marker with limited ability to predict fluid responsiveness. This prospective observational cohort study evaluated whether pulse index continuous cardiac output-guided goal-directed hemodynamic therapy (GDHT), using dynamic and volumetric hemodynamic variables, was associated with improved early graft function compared with conventional CVP-guided management in living donor kidney transplantation.MethodsEighty living donor kidney transplant recipients at Cho Ray Hospital, Vietnam, were enrolled between May 2024 and December 2025.

pmc-13727354.title: Bisphenol Analog‐Induced Cytotoxicity: Unraveling Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER) Stress and Apoptotic Pathways
pmc-13727354.creator: Rafia Afroze Rifa, Ramon Lavado
pmc-13727354.description: Bisphenol A (BPA) is increasingly replaced by structural analogs, yet their safety remains insufficiently characterized. This study investigated whether BPA and selected analogs, bisphenol AF (BPAF), bisphenol AP (BPAP), bisphenol P (BPP), and bisphenol E (BPE), induce cytotoxicity through activation of endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress and apoptosis‐related signaling in a cell‐type‐specific manner.
